text:
Priya: heads-up  proposing a subtle change: move the "peek" trigger for Notifications from the card footer to sit directly beneath channel chips. rationale: when suppression is toggled the footer is off-screen in dense lists. Any major objections? :eyes:
Tomas: fine with the move. biggest constraint is vertical rhythm in rule list rows. we need a micro-variant that doesn't bump row height.
Leah: agree on micro-variant. suggestion: compact = inline text link with a chevron-down icon that opens a small flyout; regular = small secondary button that opens the full preview panel.
Marco: keyboard flow question  where should it sit relative to the channel edit button and suppression toggle? my vote: channels -> suppression -> peek trigger -> actions. that keeps peek last so users can set suppression before previewing.
Priya: I like keeping suppression before peek too. We should document the tab order in the accessibility checklist.
A11y-Bot: recommendation: add aria-haspopup="true" and aria-controls pointing to the preview region id. Use aria-expanded on the trigger. Also ensure the flyout announces its own role="dialog" and sets aria-modal when using modal variant.
Tomas: copy note: "Peek notifications" vs "Preview notifications" vs "Show recent sends". Leaning away from "peek" for user-facing copy. Thoughts?
Leah: "Preview notifications" is clear but we've used "preview" a lot. What about "Show recent notifications"  explicit but longer. For compact maybe truncate to "Show recent" with tooltip for context.
Marco: prefer explicit: "Show recent notifications". Tooltip text can be "Shows up to 20 most recent notifications for selected channels".
Priya: good. UX edge: when suppression filters out results show badge "suppressed" inside the flyout header and a short help-line: "Some channels are suppressed; toggle suppression to see live sends."
A11y-Bot: when results change due to suppression, fire an aria-live="polite" region update: "Preview updated: X results; Y channels suppressed."
Tomas: implementation: compact flyout should lazy-load payload after user expands (avoid list render cost). Cache last successful preview per rule for 45s and show cached icon with tooltip "Showing recent cached preview".
Leah: also include a tiny "refresh" button in the flyout header that refetches and shows a spinner. Make sure refresh is reachable by keyboard and has a visible focus style.
Marco: analytics: emit event preview_open with fields: rule_id, channel_list, suppression_applied (bool), source_variant (compact|panel), cached (bool). Send preview_result_count on success.
Priya: final accessibility/clutch items: ensure color contrast for the inline link token meets AA at small sizes, visible focus ring with 3:1 contrast, and that screenreader users can trigger peek without losing context in the rule list. Add this to PR checklist.
A11y-Bot: color check: use link token L-strong on light theme and L-strong-dark on dark theme to meet 4.5:1 at 12px. Also ensure focus outline thickness is 2px minimum.
Tomas: I'll prototype compact flyout in storybook and add keyboard tests for tab order and screenreader announcements.
Leah: I'll update Figma with compact/expanded variants and copy iterations. Priya will add the checklist to the PR template.
Priya: thanks everyone  I'll drop mock links and the checklist in the design PR and mark for keyboard QA. :white_check_mark:
